name: cs2-mcp-workspace
description: Scripts for the CS2MCP MCP server (mcp-server/), its web companion (web/) and the companion's desktop app (desktop/). The bridge mod builds with dotnet.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix mcp-server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.web: npm run build:web && npm --prefix web start
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run pack
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.test: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop test
